actions.reason: K7_C0001 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: near-complete PBRM1 mutation (14/14) with strong target-versus-rest enrichment surviving driver-panel and family-wide FDR plus VHL enrichment (ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:fb2d94aafe), and a coherent metabolic/lipid-down transcriptomic program (ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:fb2d94aafe). No measured technical, acquisition, or site factor remains a significant candidate-specific alternative explanation (all q>=0.447) (ER:82111b9a8db1:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:fb2d94aafe). Membership representation is modality-dependent, with strong WXS separation but negative CT/RNA/WSI silhouettes (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fb2d94aafe); however, the decision-relevant neighboring boundaries are not merge-compatible: the K7_C0001|K7_C0004 boundary shows weak/conflicting native-view separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:64c8b42920) with a represented but single-cluster-dominated union (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:64c8b42920), and the K7_C0001|K7_C0007 boundary shows conflicting native views with strong WXS separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:777a140693) and perfect current-boundary agreement (ARI=1.0) with within-side affinity far exceeding between-side (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:777a140693). No supported split or merge alternative is available, so K7_C0001 is retained as an independent discovery-stage unit.

K7_C0002 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: near-absent VHL mutation (0/16) with strong depletion surviving driver-panel and family-wide FDR plus TP53 enrichment and PBRM1 depletion (ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:7ab5139254), and a coherent immune-cold/metabolism-high transcriptomic program (ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:7ab5139254). No measured technical, acquisition, or site factor remains a significant candidate-specific alternative explanation (all q>=0.535) (ER:82111b9a8db1:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:7ab5139254). Membership representation is weak, with negative or near-zero silhouettes across all four views (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:7ab5139254); however, the decision-relevant neighboring boundaries are not merge-compatible: K7_C0002|K7_C0003 shows weakly coherent native-view separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:b893638d10) with perfect current-boundary agreement (ARI=1.0) and within-side affinity exceeding between-side (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:b893638d10); K7_C0002|K7_C0004 shows weakly coherent separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:99b4e250ca) with moderate-to-high current-boundary agreement (ARI=0.772) (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:99b4e250ca); and K7_C0002|K7_C0005 shows weak/partially conflicting separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:8a25ae24cd) with perfect current-boundary agreement (ARI=1.0) (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:8a25ae24cd). No supported split or merge alternative is available, so K7_C0002 is retained as an independent discovery-stage unit.

K7_C0003 has an interpretable transcriptomic phenotype (interferon-alpha/gamma up-regulation with immune/inflammatory programs) (ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:2e6a394b11), but its WXS driver-panel phenotype is not coherent: no driver-panel gene survives FDR correction (ER:82111b9a8db1:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:2e6a394b11). Membership is broadly unsupported: CT/WSI show only weak positive separation while RNA and WXS are negative (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:2e6a394b11). Critically, multiple measured technical/acquisition/site factors remain significant candidate-specific alternative explanations for membership (tissue source site V=0.529, scanner model V=0.472, manufacturer V=0.366, reconstruction kernel V=0.392, slice thickness epsilon^2=0.245, z-spacing epsilon^2=0.249) (ER:82111b9a8db1:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:2e6a394b11). The relevant neighboring boundaries are weak or merge-compatible rather than independently established: K7_C0003|K7_C0007 shows limited-to-modest native-view separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:76919e50e8) with a represented but single-cluster-dominated union (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:76919e50e8); K7_C0003|K7_C0005 shows limited-to-modest separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:f1b58f2687) with a possible multi-cluster union resolution not aligned to the current two-way structure (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:f1b58f2687); and K7_C0002|K7_C0003 shows only weak separation (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:b893638d10) with a single-cluster-dominated union (ER:82111b9a8db1:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:b893638d10). With broadly unsupported membership, a plausible technical explanation, and no supported split or merge that would rescue it, K7_C0003 lacks sufficient defensible discovery value.
